name: stack
title: A lock-free stack
summary: Every worker pushes its own nodes onto one shared stack and then pops as many as it can; the page accounts for every node, and counts the ones popped twice or lost when the pop is not a compare-and-swap.

controls.name: operation
controls.label: Pop
controls.hint: cas: read the top and the node below, swing the head by compare-and-swap. broken: read, then store the head, in two steps.

results.name: popped
results.label: Popped
results.what: pops that returned a node, all workers

results.name: remaining
results.label: Still in the stack
results.what: nodes reachable from the head when every worker has finished

results.name: twice
results.label: Popped twice
results.what: nodes that more than one pop returned

results.name: lost
results.label: Lost
results.what: nodes neither popped nor in the stack

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing

trace.what: a model of two threads popping from a stack of three nodes
